# unifi_network_wlan_group (Resource)

A UniFi WLAN group (`wlangroup`, legacy `/rest`) — a named grouping of WLANs (the older organizational unit that predates AP groups). Only `name` is configurable; the controller ships a protected default group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Read-Only

- `attr_no_delete` (Boolean) Whether the controller protects this group from deletion (the built-in default group). When `true`, `terraform destroy` removes the resource from state without deleting it.
- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
